digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, LLM runner model routing
propositions: Code-review gate's five LLM steps declare per-step model classes in YAML but all execute on cfg.model, ignoring declarations.
PydanticAIRunner discards req.config.model and resolves from self._config, dropping per-step overrides computed upstream by RunnerAgentStep.
Per-call model configs computed and passed into RunRequest are invisible to the runner layer because RunRequest carries no step identity and runner uses only its own config.
Usage log cannot attribute calls to steps because it records prompt name, not step id, preventing discrimination between base step and batch finder both using code-review-base prompt.
Step 0 (observability) must add step id and declared class token to usage log via ContextVar before wiring fix can be diagnosed.
